value: Applicants seeking certification to be a cargo screening facility under 49 CFR part 1549 send TSA an application for consideration. value: While the STA application creates a corresponding information collection burden, the CCSP-K9 will need to submit information to TSA to validate their STA, the expiration of their STA and track the employees of a CCSF-K9 if their STA is revoked.
